# Frontier audit

Final level: **C2 — restricted rigorous theorem**.

## Proved

- exact gauge-invariant residual-energy identity for one `SU(2)` link star;
- spherical pairwise/Fréchet comparison under radius `< pi/2`;
- deterministic centered-coordinate transfer under an explicit remainder;
- exact oriented dependent-Gaussian covariance spectrum on the open side-two
  four-cube;
- exact minimum external-curvature quadratic form and strictly positive
  spectrum for each of eight interior links;
- conditional measure-tail wrapper with all missing constants exposed.

## Not proved

- uniform nonlinear logarithmic remainder under physical boundary states;
- absolute continuity constants comparing the interacting and Gaussian
  measures;
- a finite nonlinear coordinated link repair or its Jacobian;
- cancellation or boundary scaling for multi-star repairs;
- volume-, scale-, or history-uniform spectra;
- polymer convergence for the nonlinear theory;
- RG basin entry, continuum coherence, OS reconstruction, or mass gap.

The paper may motivate a constructive repair program but cannot be used as a
completed step beyond its finite-block and conditional scope.
